findings: All nine jobs finished green, including the trpc-cli milestone commands, merged reports, workflow-scoped telemetry and resource cleanup. All 88 non-skipped browser bodies passed with zero retries; four tests were skipped. OS Vitest had one retry: the empty agent catalogue live-state subscription test. Longest browser reporter interval: 67.8s; OS Vitest: 115.6s. First attempts started within 4.2s; peak concurrent attempts was 85. Consumer installs completed before readiness; finalizer installation completed during tests. Total: 608.5s, with 59.2 summed runner-minutes.
